title: BBC Learning English from the News 2025 — Quiz 2
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q011_tangible
elements.title: The training delivered ___ results: errors fell by half in the first month.

elements.name: q012_crushing_weight
elements.title: She felt the ___ of having to support her whole family alone.

elements.name: q013_probe
elements.title: The reporter continued to ___ for answers, asking the director about each missing payment.

elements.name: q014_pay_respects
elements.title: People placed flowers outside the theatre to ___ to the late actor.

elements.name: q015_crack_down_on_something
elements.title: The council imposed bigger fines to ___ illegal parking.

elements.name: q016_wreck
elements.title: One night of severe frost could ___ the entire crop beyond recovery.

elements.name: q017_holy_grail
elements.title: A cheap battery that lasts a week remains the ___ of phone design: everyone wants one, but nobody has made one.

elements.name: q018_legendary
elements.title: Fans still tell stories about the singer's ___ final performance decades later.

elements.name: q019_crimes_against_humanity
elements.title: Which phrase refers to grave offences committed as part of a widespread or systematic attack on civilians?

elements.name: q020_sham
elements.title: The advertised competition was a ___: there was never any prize to win.
